# Fulflit

> Cross-border logistics and fulfillment platform built for SME e-commerce brands in Pakistan and the Middle East.

Fulflit helps growing brands store inventory, ship orders, and deliver products across borders without complex logistics. The platform covers warehousing, bulk cross-border shipping, last-mile delivery, and Cash on Delivery (COD) remittance across the GCC, all from a single dashboard.
